title: Meteor Crush VR
description:
In the 2083 AD, a giant asteroid hit Mars and destroying the planet. 

The debris are heading towards our planet and threaten its existence. 

Crush their advance and prevent the meteorites to crash into our planet. 



Use your controllers to hit the meteors and crush them

Be careful though, the longer you play the faster they become

Each meteoroid that passes you will reduce your HP



Be prepared for fast paced arcade style gameplay

with unlimited playtime, great music and sound effects



Compare your score online and become the best meteor crusher for our planet.
description_short: Protect our planet from incoming meteoroids! Use your VR controllers to crush every one coming your way.
